limitations: This classification does not enumerate every product or analytics surface.

classes.returns: swap fees plus any separately validated gauge incentives
in-range swap fees plus separately validated gauge emissions when staked

classes.reason: A share-priced or yield-bearing vault has deposit/withdraw/share and strategy semantics, not an AMM invariant or pool key.
Collateral, debt, interest, liquidation, and redemption positions are credit-protocol state, not AMM liquidity.
TVL/APY/volume/price rows are derived observations and cannot establish a live executable pool, gauge, owner, or route.

routing: Route MUSD borrowing and redemption mechanics to their owning protocol modules.
Route gauge voting/emission allocation to protocols/incentives.
Route transaction submission and tracking to workflows/transactions.
Route reproduced integration failures to troubleshooting after reproduction.
